english: What is your name?
My name is Dyanna.
How are you?
I am good/ ok. Thank you.
Where are you from?
I am from Kuching.
Where are you going?
I am going to Satok.
How long do you plan to be here?
I am going to stay in Kuching for a month.
Where do you stay?

sarawak: Kamek tinggal di kawasan Petra Jaya.
malay: Saya tinggal di kawasan Petra Jaya.
english: I am staying at Petra Jaya area.
Who you came with?
I came with my sister.
What time is your flight?
My flight is at 1pm.
How many bags you have?

sarawak: Kamek ada 2 beg. Sigek besar, sigek kecik.
english: I have 2 bags. 1 big, 1 small one.
How many of you?
There are 4 of us.

sarawak: Kamek perlu ke airport sebelum 11 pagi.
malay: Saya perlu ke Lapangan Terbang sebelum jam 11 pagi.
english: I have to be at the airport by 11am.

sarawak: Pukol berapa kitak dapat ambik kamek?
malay: Jam berapa awak boleh jemput saya?
english: What time can you pick me up?
I'll pick you up by 10.30am.

sarawak: Kamek nak pegi ke Kuching Waterfront. Boleh kitak padah jeraya ke sia?
malay: Saya nak pergi ke Kuching Waterfront. Boleh tunjukkan jalan ke situ?
english: I want to go to the Kuching Waterfront. Can you please show me the way?
Walk straight up.
Turn right.
Turn left.

sarawak: Rah simpang tiga, masuk ke lorong belah kerek.
malay: Jumpa simpang tiga, masuk ke lorong sebelah kiri.
english: At the T junction, take a left turn.

sarawak: Limpas bus stop, kakya jalan terus sampai nangga sungei.
malay: Lalu depan perhentian bas, lepas itu jalan terus hingga nampak sungai.
english: Walk straight up until u pass by a bus stop, continue along the road until you see a river.

sarawak: Ari apa kitak nak pegi Lundu?
malay: Hari apa awak nak pegi ke Lundu?
english: What day do you plan to go to Lundu?
I want to go on Friday.
What time you want to go?
I want to go at 9 am.

sarawak: Berapa lamak nak sampe ke Lundu?
english: How long does it take to reach Lundu?

sarawak: Dalam 2 jam perjalanan. Kol 11 pagi sampe sia.
malay: Dalam 2 jam perjalanan. Jam 11 pagi sampai di situ.
english: Within 2 hours drive. Will reach there by 11 am.

malay: Saya nak order 2 laksa biasa, 1 special.
english: I want to order 2 bowls of regular laksa, 1 bowl of special laksa.

sarawak: Kamek nak order 3 igek teh peng.
malay: Saya nak order 3 gelas teh ais.
english: I want to order 3 glasses of iced tea.

sarawak: Kamek nak tambah sigek gik Mi Kolok.
malay: Saya nak tambah lagi satu Mi Kolok.
english: I want to add 1 Kolok Mee.
Do you sell Sarawak Batik?
What is the total?
Can i have a little discount?
Can i have the receipt, please?
Can i see Mr Douglas, please?
I have an appointment at 9 am.

sarawak: Dudok lok kitak, kamek nunggah Encik Douglas.
malay: Duduk dulu ya, saya panggilkan Encik Douglas.
english: Please have a seat first, i'll go get Mr. Douglas.

sarawak: Boleh tulong kitak printkan dokumen nok diperlu tek?
Laporan ya perlu siap sebelum minggu depan tok.
malay: Laporan perlu siap sebelum minggu depan.

sarawak: Tulong padah dengan semua, 'meeting' di tunda ke ari Rabu.
malay: Tolong beritahu semua mesyuarat di tunda ke hari Rabu.
